page.overview:
Who is Abbadona Hellgore?

Hieronymus planned on escaping along with Abbadona and their son. However, the Blood Monks caught up with them before they could board their ship. Hieronymus sacrificed himself so Abbadona and the child could escape. Abbadona would later do the same, leaving the child orphaned.

Fueled by the death of his parents, their son became the Imperator, and embarked in a journey to eradicate magic and magic users from every dimension.
